70:40.text: So I swear by the Lord of

70:41.text: To replace them with better than them; and We are not to be outdone.

70:42.text: So leave them to converse vainly and amuse themselves until they meet their Day which they are promised -

70:43.text: The Day they will emerge from the graves rapidly as if they were, toward an erected idol, hastening.

70:44.text: Their eyes humbled, humiliation will cover them. That is the Day which they had been promised.

71:1.text: Indeed, We sent Noah to his people,
, "Warn your people before there comes to them a painful punishment."

71:2.text: He said, "O my people, indeed I am to you a clear warner -

71:3.text: To worship Allāh, fear Him and obey me.

71:4.text: will forgive you of your sins and delay you for a specified term. Indeed, the time
Allāh, when it comes, will not be delayed, if you only knew."

71:5.text: He said, "My Lord, indeed I invited my people

71:6.text: But my invitation increased them not except in flight

71:7.text: And indeed, every time I invited them that You may forgive them, they put their fingers in their ears, covered themselves with their garments,

71:9.text: Then I announced to them and

71:10.text: And said, 'Ask forgiveness of your Lord. Indeed, He is ever a Perpetual Forgiver.
